description:
When starting the TUI, a build system message 'make: Nothing to be done for `all`.' leaks into the output.

OBSERVED:
==> octo_pi_tui_terminal
make: Nothing to be done for `all`.

 octo_pi v0.1.0

EXPECTED:
The TUI should start cleanly without any build system messages. Only the application banner and hints should appear.
title: TUI-10: 'make: Nothing to be done' build message leaks into TUI
